sloka: कैकेय्या विनियुक्तेन पाप अभिजन भावया ।मया न मन्त्र कुशलैः वृद्धैः सह समर्थितम् ॥२-५९-१८॥
transliteration: kaikeyyā viniyuktena pāpa abhijana bhāvayā ।mayā na mantra kuśalaiḥ vṛddhaiḥ saha samarthitam ॥2-59-18॥

translations.english: I did not see any difference in the degree of anguish among friends, those who are not friends and and those who are indifferent. (The degree of agony was same in all).
